name: BambuStudio
description: App-update notify; Bambu Network Plug-in auto-downloads a zip and loads it into the process with no verification.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: BambuStudio’s retained source loads a separately stored networking module and includes conditional publisher-certificate checks; the claimed automatic plug-in ZIP retrieval and its verification behavior remain unresolved.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; the optional Bambu Network Plug-in implementation and acquisition service may be outside this repository.

original_evidence.text: | BambuStudio | github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio | wxWidgets/C++ (libcurl) | Y (app-version notify; separate auto-downloaded "Bambu Network Plug-in" binary) | app update: check automatic + notify, opens browser only (`wxLaunchDefaultBrowser`).
